name: Norske helligdager – fullstendig flerspråklig (1947–2030)
title: Norske helligdager – fullstendig flerspråklig (1947–2030)
description: Comprehensive Norwegian national public holidays (helligdager) from 1947 (the year Labor Day and Constitution Day were codified by the 1947-04-26-1 act) through 2030. Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/norway.py. Multilingual names in Norwegian (no, native), English (en_US), Thai (th), and Ukrainian (uk) — all four supported_languages of the vacanza Norway class. Each record carries the Gregorian date, multilingual weekday and holiday names, the public-holiday category marker, and a national-scope flag. Sundays are NOT included (include_sundays=False) because the dataset focuses on statutory holidays only; while Norway legally considers every Sunday a holiday under the 1947 act, including all 52 Sundays per year would dilute the statutory-holiday signal. Norway's 17 fylker (counties/regions) have no county-specific public holidays in vacanza/holidays (no _populate_subdiv_XX_public_holidays methods defined), so this single national dataset covers all 17 subdivisions uniformly. This is a comprehensive upgrade of the prior thin no-helligdager dataset (84 records, 2020–2026, only no+en) — same source, broader window, four languages.

meta.title: Norske helligdager – fullstendig flerspråklig (1947–2030) - Gratis nedlasting
meta.description: Comprehensive Norwegian national public holidays (helligdager) from 1947 (the year Labor Day and Constitution Day were codified by the 1947-04-26-1 act) through 2030. Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/norway.py. Multilingual names in Norwegian (no, native), English (en_US), Thai (th), and Ukrainian (uk) — all four supported_languages of the vacanza Norway class. Each record carries the Gregorian date, multilingual weekday and holiday names, the public-holiday category marker, and a national-scope flag. Sundays are NOT included (include_sundays=False) because the dataset focuses on statutory holidays only; while Norway legally considers every Sunday a holiday under the 1947 act, including all 52 Sundays per year would dilute the statutory-holiday signal. Norway's 17 fylker (counties/regions) have no county-specific public holidays in vacanza/holidays (no _populate_subdiv_XX_public_holidays methods defined), so this single national dataset covers all 17 subdivisions uniformly. This is a comprehensive upgrade of the prior thin no-helligdager dataset (84 records, 2020–2026, only no+en) — same source, broader window, four languages. Inneholder 1000 poster. Last ned i Excel, CSV, PDF format.
